## What does this change?

A short description of what changed and why.

## How did you test it?

Describe what you actually did in the running app to confirm this works
(there's no full automated test suite for playback/UI yet - see
`CONTRIBUTING.md`). If you added or changed a pure-logic function, please
add a test under `test/` (`node --test`, no new dependency needed).

## Checklist

- [ ] I've read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I've added a `CHANGELOG.md` entry (if this is a user-facing change)
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run build` completes without errors
